Overview

El Calafate is a city in Santa Cruz with a population of 28,000. Patagonia’s glacier tourism capital on the shores of Lake Argentino, gateway to Perito Moreno Glacier. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.
